content.text:
Built **Starling: Last Light**, a complete browser arcade survival game in `index.html`.

- Survive five escalating waves, destroy enemies, collect scrap, and recover shields.
- Keyboard and mouse controls on desktop; touch joystick and fire button on mobile.
- Includes pause/resume, win/loss screens, HUD, and replay.
- Verified it runs in Chromium, including firing-game rendering and pause/resume.

Assumption: the project had no existing game or design brief, so I created a standalone arcade game.
